description: Masses d'eau souterraines de Wallonie - listes, fiches et cartographie is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles. En Dev - liaison ArcGis - Ne pas utiliser The 6 datasets in this record: Etat des masses d'eau souterraines - cartographie; Fiches de caractérisation des masses d’eau souterraines; Liste descriptive des masses d'eau souterraine; Masses d'eau souterraines (MESo); Masses d'eau souterraines - Liste; Masses d'eau souterraines wallonnes. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal lists 6 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal shows 49 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The most recent modification among them is 2026-09-30 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
